oracle.question: Does Agent Hive improve answer quality enough to justify its latency and token cost?
oracle.rag: local BM25 top-3 + one gpt-5.6-sol call
oracle.hive: scout -> forager -> builder -> guard; every cell uses gpt-5.6-sol
oracle.adaptiveMemoryHive: scoped evidence memory + goal controller + hooks + early stop + at most one guard repair; every model call uses gpt-5.6-sol
oracle.accuracyLockedMicroHive: token-budgeted atomic evidence + one compact gpt-5.6-sol call + deterministic accuracy lock + one full-context fallback when the lock fails
oracle.loss: taskLoss = 1 - HotpotQA token F1; exactLoss = 1 - exact match
